name: Michael Grinich
profile: Software founder who previously co-founded email-API company Nylas, then launched WorkOS in March 2020 to give developers plug-in enterprise features (SSO, SCIM directory sync, audit logs, permissions). In March 2026 WorkOS raised a $100M Series C at a $2B valuation led by Meritech and Sapphire. Customers include OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Cursor and Perplexity, and it is pushing into auth for AI agents.
interesting_fact: WorkOS sells 'enterprise readiness' to AI labs: OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Cursor, Perplexity and Replit all use it. Grinich argues that as software becomes autonomous, 'trust becomes the constraint.'
deep_cut_fact: In 2022 WorkOS bought Modulz, maker of the popular open-source Radix UI framework. Angels in that $80M Series B included Hollywood super-agent Michael Ovitz, Guillermo Rauch and Jack Altman.

public_contacts.value: Crossing the Enterprise Chasm (WorkOS podcast featuring Grinich): https://workos.com/podcast

notes: Very reachable founder: active on X (@grinich, ~15.7K followers, and grinich.com redirects there) and runs a B2B podcast, so it is a natural fit for a podcast invite. The Nylas background is from general knowledge; no fetched source was re-checked because web-search quota ran out.

name: Nick Reber
profile: Founded Garner Health, which analyses large medical-claims datasets to rank doctors on quality and cost, then steers employees of self-insured employers to top performers and reimburses their out-of-pocket costs. He was earlier on Oscar Health's leadership team (analytics, provider networks) and a partner at Bridgewater Associates. Hurun values Garner at ~$1B+.
interesting_fact: Garner applies hedge-fund-style data analysis to healthcare: its leadership includes several Bridgewater alumni, and it scores physicians on outcomes to cut employer spend.
deep_cut_fact: Before healthcare, Reber was a partner at Bridgewater Associates, where he co-headed Research Analytics. At Oscar Health he then helped oversee growth to over $2B in revenue.
notes: Low-key founder with few personal social accounts found; the best route is Garner's PR email. Garner also runs a podcast and webinars (Resources section).
